releaseTitle: XECEAY v1.1.0 — Fixed Wrong Song Playback, Looping & Real Stream Audio Engine
changelog: Completely fixed wrong song playback caused by local fallback hashing, eliminated 30s audio looping and fake durations, fixed FLAC badge on MP3 downloads, sorted Khmer & Global search results by relevance, deleted synthetic sine-wave WAV generation, and added multi-hop HTTP/HTTPS redirect stream resolution.
